input.quote: a) IBM may perform process audits at MSL's or an MSL Related Company's Work Center or MSL's subcontractors' facilities to assure that identified IBM specifications have been complied with.
input.rationale: Every audit, inspection and verification right in the Agreement runs in our favour, not against us: Section 7.0 process audits (p0163-p0164), Attachment 6 Section 4.0 software-location monitoring/inspection/audit (p1310-p1314), Attachment 6 Section 4 books-and-records audits and inspections of MSL and its Subsidiaries (p1443, at MSL's facilities, 45 days' written notice, independent CPA, MSL pays only if material discrepancies are disclosed) (p1448), consigned inventory and tooling inspections, and acceptance/source inspection. Section 16.14 Records is a mutual record-retention obligation only and confers no examination right over IBM. MSL has no right to audit, inspect or access IBM's records, facilities or systems anywhere in the document, so there is no audit exposure against the Customer to limit — the position is better than the preferred checklist (no frequency, notice, cost or system-access constraints are needed because no Vendor audit right exists). Nothing to redline; flagging the IBM-favourable audit rights would weaken our own position.
